data.long_meaning: From the Old English words 'heah' meaning 'high' and 'dun' meaning 'hill' or 'fort'. The name Heydon is thought to have originated as a nickname for someone living on a high hill or fort. The name is associated with the fiery nature of the elements and the strong bonds of friendship. The name Heydon carries the meaning “Fire, friend” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Heydon usually hope their child will grow to embody fire, friend and live with faith, good character and purpose.
